spans.s: गोष्ठः [gōṣṭhḥ] ष्ठम् [ṣṭham], ष्ठम् [गावस्तिष्ठन्त्यत्र घञर्थे क षत्वम्] (Usually गोष्ठम् only)
An abode, place of living; गोष्ठान् हरीणां गिरिसेतुमालाः
An epithet of Śiva. -ष्ठम् A purificatory श्राद्ध ceremony; वाच्यं गोष्ठे तु सुश्रुतम्

. ˚पतिः a chief herdsman. ˚वेदिका a mound or altar in a cowpen. ˚श्वः a dog in a cowpen which barks at every one; applied figuratively to a slanderous person, one who stays idly at home and slanders his neighbours. गोष्ठेपण्डितः 'wise in a cowpen,' a braggart, vain boaster. गोष्ठेक्ष्वेडिन् m. a boasting coward; also गोष्ठपटु, गोष्ठेप्रगल्भः, -शूरः &c.
An assembly, meeting; मध्ये विरेजतुरलं पशुपालगोष्ठ्यां रङ्गे यथा नटवरौ क्व च गायमानौ
Conversation, chitchat, discourse; क्वचिद्विद्वद्गोष्ठी क्वचिदपि सुरामत्तकलहः
A multitude or collection; मोदन्तां सततं च बान्धवसुहृद्गोष्ठीप्रमोदाः प्रजाः
Family connections, relatives, especially such as require to be maintained.
A kind of dramatic composition in one act. ˚पतिः
the chief of an assembly, president.
गोष्ठ् [gōṣṭh], 1 Ā. (गोष्ठते) To assemble, collect, heap together.
The mark or impression of a cow's foot in the soil.
The quantity of water sufficient to fill such an impression; i. e. a very small puddle; गोष्पदे संप्लुतोदके
. ˚प्रम् (णमुल्) in such a manner that a cow's foortprint be filled; ददाल भूर्नभो रक्तं गोष्पदप्रं ववर्ष च
As much as a cows foot-step will hold.
